# Indexed iterator result and closed declared exceptions

Independently authored Java8 factories retain one invariant Iterator<E>, an exact
integer context and the original E result with a declared IndexOutOfBoundsException.
The frozen observer checks exact indices, iterator identity/actions, provider and
bridge failures, opaque results, ignored calls and delayed String casts. All
source/SDK output units compile and retain original metadata, roles, Exceptions
and helper accounting. Private application bytes and behavior are excluded.
